records.question: Is 17 litres an amount I should always add when filling?
records.answer: No. The listed 17.0 L tank capacity is approximate; actual filling capacity varies. If refuelling, first turn the engine and handheld electronic devices OFF, use a well-ventilated area with no smoking, flames or sparks, and open the cap slowly. Gasoline vapour is highly explosive. Fill only to the bottom of the anti-splash plate to leave expansion space; overfilling can damage the evaporative-emission system. Avoid spills on painted surfaces and wipe any spill off immediately to prevent a permanent stain.
